summary: V50.z256 Rilevamento Visite Clienti tested end-to-end. Backend: 27/27 pytest tests pass covering /visits/settings defaults + clamps (999→120) + invalid-mode→both fallback, /user-settings PUT round-trip for visit_detection, /visits/confirm (manual/GPS-haversine/km-log side-effect), /visits/delete cascading km-log removal, /visits/contact aggregation, /visits/summary, /visits/due with revisit_every_days, /visits/candidates dedup+list+dismiss+confirm-with-cand_id, /visits/nearby (radius filter), /geo/optimal-route+/geo/km-log leg → auto-visit with source='route' → DELETE cascades, tenant isolation (sub1 sees owner visits, demo does not, unauth=401). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): settings section renders (testID visit-detection-settings) and all pill/mode/recap-time interactions persist via /api/visits/settings (verified stay_minutes=15, radius_m=200, mode='both', recap_time='19:00'). Contact card tab-visits renders on c_343d523c463f with Frequenza ripasso pills (visit-freq-60 → status 'Ultima visita … · prossimo ripasso tra 60 gg'), manual visit form (toggle→km→notes→save) opens correctly. Optimal route /optimal-route filter row (route-notsince-filter) and due badges (route-due-<id>) render — filter buttons clickable.

issues: When a visit is deleted, contacts.last_visit_at is NOT reset — the visit-freq-status banner may keep showing 'Ultima visita 0 gg fa' with '0 visite · 0,0 km' header (mild data-hygiene inconsistency, not blocker).

action_items: OPTIONAL: on DELETE /api/visits/{id}, recompute contact.last_visit_at from the remaining most-recent visit (currently it keeps the stale value → status banner shows 'Ultima visita 0 gg fa' after deleting the only visit).
OPTIONAL: PUT /api/contacts/{id} does not accept nulling last_visit_at (field not in ContactUpdate) — not required by the feature, only surfaced during test cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: contact_visits.py: /visits/summary iterates ALL visits for tenant sorted by 'at' desc but never breaks on first per-contact — it walks the whole cursor. For high-volume tenants this could be slow; consider aggregation pipeline with $group first, $sort with limit.
geo_km_log.py cascades delete via db.contact_visits.delete_many({km_entry_id}) — correct. Inverse cascade (DELETE /visits/{id} → delete km-log entry) also correct; both directions verified.

contact_visits.py _cv_insert_visit sets contacts.last_visit_at unconditionally on insert; on visit DELETE the field is not recomputed → stale UI banner after deleting the only visit (design_issues above).
VisitDetectionSettings.tsx uses Pressable + testID Pill component — all pills tappable in web via pointer/mouse event chain.
seed_data_creation: None persisted; every test cleans up its visits/candidates/km-log entries and TestZCleanup resets visit_detection to defaults + unsets revisit_every_days.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via UI works ONLY with a React-Native-Web-compatible input filler + Pressable event chain: use nativeInputValueSetter on data-testid elements (reset _valueTracker first) and dispatch pointerdown+mousedown+pointerup+mouseup+click on Pressables. Token stored via AsyncStorage web (not directly readable from localStorage in all cases). API /api/geo/optimal-route requires origin_lat/origin_lon or origin_address (not 'origin' object) and contact_ids (not 'contacts').
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature is implemented correctly and all requested test scenarios pass on both layers.
